```{r}
# data exploration 

sample<-Read10X(sample)
endo_raw<-CreateSeuratObject(counts=sample,project="HECA")

endo_raw[["raw.percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(endo_raw, pattern = "^MT-")
vln_features <- VlnPlot(endo_raw, features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 0.1) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes per cell",
    x = NULL 
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)
  ) + NoLegend()

vln_counts <- VlnPlot(endo_raw, features = "nCount_RNA", pt.size = 0.1) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    y = "Total counts per cell",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)
  ) + NoLegend()
vln_mt <- VlnPlot(endo_raw, features = "raw.percent.mt", pt.size = 0.1) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    y = "Mitochondrial gene expression (%)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)
  ) + NoLegend()

figure1_row1 <-
  (
    (vln_features | vln_counts | vln_mt) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = "Quality control metrics",
        theme = theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
        )
      )
  )

# filtering and visualisation

endo<-CreateSeuratObject(counts=sample,project="endo",min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
endo[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(endo, pattern = "^MT-")

plot1 <- FeatureScatter(endo, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8), axis.title.x = element_text(size=11), axis.text.x = element_text(size=8), plot.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
  NoLegend()
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(endo, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8), axis.title.x = element_text(size=11), axis.text.x = element_text(size=8), plot.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
  NoLegend()


# variable feature selection

endo<-FindVariableFeatures(endo, selection.method="vst", nfeatures=2000)
top10<-head(VariableFeatures(endo), 10)
plot3<-VariableFeaturePlot(endo)
plot4<-LabelPoints(plot=plot3, points=top10, repel=TRUE)
variable_features_plot <- plot4 + ylab("Standardised Variance") + NoLegend() + ggtitle("Top variable genes") + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), axis.text.x = element_text(size=8), axis.text.y = element_text(size=8), axis.title.x = element_text(size=11), axis.title.y = element_text(size=11))


# normalisation

endo <- NormalizeData(endo)


# scaling

endo<-ScaleData(endo, features = VariableFeatures(endo))
```
